outcomes.intended_user_result: An operator can retain and import one bounded OMP JSONL history with exact source identity, chunked visible text, quarantine, and resumable progress.
outcomes.current_baseline: NOESIS captures live OMP observations but has no historical OMP JSONL importer.
outcomes.acceptance: Preflight, raw retention, chunking, quarantine, resume, scope, idempotency, and native archive/restore pass on disposable stores without model work or OMP configuration changes.

excluded_scope: No new Mind tool or management surface.
No provider proxy, model, embedding, summary, Origami, or automatic compaction change.
No live installation, remote push, or publication.
